item.title: US military kills four alleged narco-terrorists in lethal strike on drug-trafficking vessel in Eastern Pacific
item.summary: U.S. Southern Command says Joint Task Force Southern Spear killed four alleged narco-terrorists in a strike on an Eastern Pacific trafficking vessel.

item.title: From Iran to the fake Jesus image, Trump is facing a growing backlash for his inflammatory rhetoric
item.summary: Trump deleted an AI image of himself as Jesus after backlash from Catholic leaders and conservative allies, reigniting debate over his mental fitness.

item.title: Suspect in string of random attacks in Georgia is naturalized citizen from UK, DHS says
item.summary: The suspect in a string of random attacks in Georgia, including in the killing of a DHS employee, is a naturalized U.S. citizen from the U.K., according to the agency.

item.title: Suspect arrested after housekeeper tied up, attacked in Massachusetts mansion heist
item.summary: A suspect was arrested after two masked men allegedly broke into a Beverly, Massachusetts, mansion and attacked a housekeeper before fleeing with money and valuables.

item.title: TPUSA reporter attacked at ICE protest warns a dark new line has been crossed in America’s political wars
item.summary: Reporter Savanah Hernandez says she was attacked multiple times at a Minneapolis anti-ICE protest and is pushing for full charges against suspects.

item.title: Suspect in Sam Altman Molotov cocktail plot cries meltdown, not attempted murder, as judge keeps him locked up
item.summary: Daniel Moreno-Gama is held without bail on attempted murder charges after allegedly firebombing OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's San Francisco residence.

item.title: House avoids unprecedented four-member expulsion week as Swalwell and Gonzales resign instead
item.summary: Two House members resigned amid scandals, but potential expulsions of Reps. Cherfilus-McCormick and Mills raise parity and political math concerns.

item.title: New video shows Oklahoma high school principal tackling gunman who opened fire inside the school
item.summary: New video shows Oklahoma high school principal Kirk Moore tackling a gunman and wrestling the weapon away from him after he allegedly opened fire inside Pauls Valley High School.

item.title: ‘Bachelorette’ star Taylor Frankie Paul won’t face new domestic violence charges
item.summary: Taylor Frankie Paul avoids new domestic violence charges as Salt Lake County prosecutors cite statute of limitations and lack of sufficient evidence.

item.title: Colorado highway descends into chaos after massive 75-vehicle pileup, amid hazardous winter weather
item.summary: Authorities say dozens of vehicles were caught in a pileup on a snow-covered stretch of I-70, forcing a major shutdown near the Eisenhower Tunnel.
